groups.sentence: Instructors have students complete writing assignments and other coursework in class rather than outside class.
Instructors are moving toward in-class, proctored assessments and heavier exam weighting because AI makes unsupervised work less reliable.
The university invests in staffed, AI-free in-person spaces where students complete extended assignments or exams.
Instructors move exams and significant graded assessments to in-person, in-class formats.
Instructors may use lockdown browsers or proctoring tools such as Respondus or Honorlock for online or take-home assessments.
Instructors may have students work in front of them or restrict the devices and technology students can have during exams.
Proctoring and lockdown tools are available to instructors, and wearable smart devices can provide AI assistance.
Students complete all assessments in the classroom, by hand and without digital devices or technology.
Instructors base at least half of course points on demonstrations of understanding.
